description: Azure Data Factory pipeline: land raw fraud CSVs from Blob Storage into ADLS Gen2 for Databricks ingestion. Validates file existence, copies with lineage metadata, and triggers the Databricks silver notebook on success.

properties.description: Daily ingestion of fraud transaction CSVs from source Blob into the bronze zone of ADLS Gen2. Runs at 02:00 UTC (before business hours). Fails fast on missing file so downstream jobs are never triggered on stale data.

activities.name: act_validate_source_file
activities.description: Verify the source file landed in Blob Storage before attempting the copy. Waits up to 30 minutes with a 60-second retry interval. Pipeline fails if file does not arrive — downstream jobs are never triggered on a missing file.

activities.name: act_copy_to_adls
activities.description: Copy the validated CSV from Blob Storage into the bronze zone of ADLS Gen2. Preserves the original file exactly — no transformation at this stage (same philosophy as the PostgreSQL bronze layer).

activities.name: act_log_control_result
activities.description: Write a control record (file name, row count from copy activity output, load timestamp) to the audit table in Azure SQL Database. Mirrors the audit.etl_run_log pattern from the PostgreSQL bronze layer.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}' AS run_id, '@{pipeline().parameters.source_file}' AS source_file, @{activity('act_copy_to_adls').output.rowsRead} AS rows_read, @{activity('act_copy_to_adls').output.rowsCopied} AS rows_copied, GETUTCDATE() AS loaded_at, 'SUCCEEDED' AS status

activities.name: act_trigger_databricks_silver
activities.description: Trigger the Databricks silver notebook once the file is confirmed in ADLS. Passes the ADLS path as a parameter so the notebook reads the correct file.

ls_blob_source.description: Source: where the upstream system drops the daily CSV file

ls_adls_bronze.description: Sink: ADLS Gen2 bronze zone — raw files land here, Databricks reads from here

ls_azure_sql_audit.description: Audit database — same schema as the PostgreSQL audit layer (etl_run_log)

ls_databricks.description: Databricks workspace — ADF triggers the silver notebook after a successful copy

ds_adls_bronze_fraud.description: Landing zone in ADLS Gen2 bronze container
